title: CIBIL Score Low
problemDescription: Customer CIBIL score below threshold for loan approval.
solutionSteps:
1. Pull CIBIL report
2. Check for errors and dispute
3. Wait 30 days for update

title: API Connectivity Error
problemDescription: Cannot connect to upstream API endpoint.
solutionSteps:
1. Verify network connectivity
2. Check DNS resolution
3. Retry after 60 seconds

title: Document Upload Failed
solutionSteps:
1. Check file size (max 5MB)
2. Convert to PDF
3. Retry upload
